tools.name: browser_goto_url
tools.title: Browser Goto Url
tools.description: Open a URL in a new page with configurable waiting.

timeout.description:
Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the page to load
(default 30000).

wait_selector.description:
Optional CSS selector to wait for after navigation,
e.g. a container that must finish rendering. Use it when the page
loads content asynchronously.

wait_timeout.description:
Maximum time in milliseconds to wait for the selector
(defaults to ``timeout``).

tools.name: browser_screenshot
tools.title: Browser Screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the current (most recently opened) page.

page_index.description: Which page to capture. -1 means the most recent page.

full_page.description:
Whether to capture the full scrollable page (True) or only
the visible viewport (False).

session_id.description:
Optional owning conversation id. When provided the PNG is
persisted into the MooFile attachment store (db_attachments_*) and
the returned file_id can be rendered in the conversation with the
placeholder ``[图片: <file_id>]``. When omitted the screenshot is
saved under ./screenshots and the absolute path is returned
(legacy behaviour, usable with a file-read tool).

tools.name: browser_get_content
tools.title: Browser Get Content
tools.description: Extract the current page content in a model-friendly form.

format.description:
One of "text" (readable page text), "html" (raw page HTML), or
"xml" (a simplified XML element tree). The XML tree annotates every
element with its key attributes and a `css="..."` selector path so
it can be used directly to locate elements for click/fill actions.

max_length.description: Maximum characters returned for text/html output.

max_depth.description: Maximum DOM depth in the XML element tree.

max_nodes.description: Maximum number of elements in the XML element tree.

page_index.description: Which page to read. -1 means the most recent page.

tools.name: browser_execute_js
tools.title: Browser Execute Js
tools.description:
Execute JavaScript in the current page and return its result.

Use this to verify elements before acting on them: check that a selector
matches, read an element's state, or extract a value (e.g.
``document.querySelector('#submit') !== null``,
``document.querySelectorAll('.item').length``). The result is returned as
JSON when it is structured, otherwise as its string form.

script.description:
JavaScript expression to evaluate in the page's main frame.
For multi-statement logic wrap it in an IIFE, e.g.
``(function(){ var el = document.querySelector('#x'); return el ? el.value : null; })()``.

page_index.description: Which page to run on. -1 means the most recent page.

tools.name: do_automation_by_script
tools.title: Do Automation By Script
tools.description:
Execute browser automation steps from a JSON script file.

The JSON file must contain a list of step lists. Each step list is passed to
the browser automation runner, which supports navigation, interaction,
waiting, text extraction, and screenshots. ``wait_user`` controls
visibility: True shows the browser window, False runs it headless.

The browser stays resident after the call on purpose, so later tool calls
(browser_screenshot / browser_get_content / further automation) reuse the
same instance instead of relaunching Edge. It is torn down when this MCP
process exits.

script_param_file.description: Path to the UTF-8 encoded JSON automation script. Sample file placed in the ./samples folder.

wait_user.description: Whether to show the browser window (True) or run headless (False).
